deferred.reason: Only same-UUID DataVersion 5023 open_barrel 3->5 and leave_game 2->3 are covered by this composite. Legacy private Statistics refusal, DFU, unknown named/numeric IDs, time/freeze semantics, contention and full counter gameplay remain unverified; no verified-family promotion.

No legacy UUID migration, DFU, failed-load fixtures, unknown-ID sentinels, equipment/offhand/ender inventory, nondefault selected slot/dimension/respawn, gameplay for recipes/attributes/Brain/post-effects, XP wire decoding, signed/online identity or network-security claim. No third server boot to reload the destination's final mutation.

scope:
Bounded, actual same-identity 26.3 player interchange in both directions.

Exactly four sequential server boots: fresh Java -> Rust and fresh Rust -> Java.
Each source uses two real logins to establish a loaded nonzero enchantment seed.
Seven composite scenario IDs per direction cover received inventory/position/health,
typed live identity/XP, advancements, and actual requested statistics continuation.
Whole worlds are copied unchanged after clean disconnect/save/stop. No UUID
rewrites, external conversion, synthetic save mutation or player-directory rename.
Only open_barrel and leave_game statistics are asserted; time counters, opaque-field
gameplay and a third-boot continuation are not verified.
Requires --accept-eula, the cached official reference, pinned JDK25 and an existing
Rust binary on clean committed source. This module does nothing when imported.

statistics.layout_witness: Pinned inner JAR: ClientboundAwardStatsPacket map(Stat.STREAM_CODEC, VAR_INT); Stat dispatches STAT_TYPE then StatType value registry. ServerboundClientCommandPacket.Action.REQUEST_STATS ordinal 1; corroborated by local award_stats.rs/client_command.rs.
statistics.scope: Names only from these reports; other wellformed numeric entries remain unnamed observations.

experience.scope: Both query counts and +4 continuation are bytecode-derived expectations, not prior runtime observations. Only initial XpP is corroborated by the stopped Java source; its first run failed before the post-award query or transfer.

enchantment_seed.scope: Exact pinned inner JAR above; source prelude observes a real saved zero -> loaded nonzero for Java. No equality between independently generated random seeds across runtimes.

primary_contracts.scope: Exact literal item_name/custom_name through the shared client codec; no rendering normalization.
